subject.title: [Bug]: Runtime tool surface returns blank body after gateway-touching operations; container restart only briefly clears it

question: Should maintainers first require raw logs or live-session inspection before any fix PR, or is the current reporter/comment trace sufficient to start a maintainer-owned source isolation pass?
rationale: The report has multiple current-release repro timelines, but the root cause crosses gateway restart drain, session compaction, session lifecycle, lock cleanup, and tool-result extraction, and the suggested recovery surfaces would change operator-facing session behavior.

options.title: Inspect live logs first
options.body: Use the offered session logs or a live target to identify whether restart deferral, compaction, locks, or tool-result conversion owns the blank-body state before implementing a fix.

options.title: Sponsor recovery surface
options.body: Approve a session reset/tools_status design as part of the repair if maintainers want an operator-visible escape hatch in addition to root-cause cleanup.

options.title: Track under broader session management
options.body: If the root issue is lifecycle control rather than blank output, move the recovery-command work to the broader session-management issues and keep this issue focused on the silent tool-result regression.

recommendation.title: Inspect live logs first
recommendation.body: Use the offered session logs or a live target to identify whether restart deferral, compaction, locks, or tool-result conversion owns the blank-body state before implementing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the adjacent session-lock retry and tool-output merge history and is the best available routing owner from the inspected history.
